task_description: Build a Python AI backend for LangkahKampus university admission predictor. Includes ML model training (XGBoost), FastAPI endpoints for prediction/recommendation/AI advisor, Fireworks AI integration for LLM-based explanations, Docker containerization with docker-compose orchestrating PHP frontend + Python backend + MySQL, and PHP integration layer with fallback to deterministic formula.

verification.summary: All 44 pytest tests pass (including sanitization, API, predictor, and SIDATA tests). Both Docker images (ai-backend and php-frontend) build successfully. ML model (XGBoost, 6 features, R2=0.9457) is trained and produces valid predictions. FastAPI endpoints all respond correctly. Two review passes completed and all issues addressed: SIDATA mounted in container, CORS fixed, auth hardened (internal-only), score validation added, injection sanitization with test coverage, context injection mitigated, error format standardized.
